opening.argument: The presentation promotes BOTT by directing viewers to register, activate an app, select an investment package, and expect continuing profits, including stated daily returns tied to the amount invested. It attributes those profits to crypto trading through the bot: "Which generates profits by trading crypto through BOTT." It also presents referral-based income, with recruits placed into successive levels and bonuses linked to their activity: "Similarly, if he also subscribes to anyone, he will join you again on your second level. And in the second level, you also get 10 a bonus." Rank rewards and team-business thresholds further connect benefits to participant recruitment and referral activity. The slides reinforce investment, daily-bonus, and large-reward claims. The available record does not establish whether payments, losses, platform operation, or advertised returns actually occurred.
